structured.answer: Hold it at Psagot and buy the Yalin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) tracker fund (5139282); on 10k now plus 500 a month for 10 years that's 86,492 ₪ in today's money. Which broker you use matters about five times more than which fund (a 22,985 ₪ gap against 4,492 ₪), though I don't believe the Meitav figure.

findings.what: Meitav Trade ending at 63,507, about 23k below Psagot on 70k of deposits, looks plainly off
A broker name (Psagot) is highlighted in the hero box and starred, and there's no visible disclosure of who is behind the site or whether anyone is paid
A 0% management fee shown without explanation; it looks too good
A one-year 'beat the index' figure shown as if it meant something
iShares row figure is based on data that hasn't been collected yet
The same tag chips repeat on every fund row, so you re-read them to find the difference
Bar colours and their cost numbers are separated
Unlabeled ticks on the range strips; you have to use the legend
